prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Telecom churn prediction
client: confidential
client_industry: telecom
start: 2021-01
end: 2021-03
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Python
- XGBoost
- pandas
- SHAP
- MLflow
implied_skills:
- model explainability
built: A monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the
  retention team could read.
metrics:
- AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter
- top-decile lift 3.1x

The review is from: a client in telecom (name withheld)
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "model explainability".
text: Noor did solid work on our telecom churn prediction project. They built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers and included per-customer SHAP reasons that our retention team could actually read. The model reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and delivered 3.1x top-decile lift. Clear, reliable, and easy to work with throughout the engagement.
